page.layout: Two printed columns below a full-width opening paragraph and a short italic paragraph. Above the columns, a centred section number "5." and the column headings "Veteres." (left) and "Hodierni." (right). Below the columns, one full-width paragraph continuing the left column. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: strium[?] noverint & Archidiaconum vocent: Archidiaconus vero eandem consecrationem habet quam cæteri Diaconi, sed electione fratrum præponitur: ergo eandem olim habebat Epis-copus consecrationem quam presbyteri.

p.i: Quod ad ritus & ceremonias in consecratione usi-tatas, iidem fere prorsus sunt cum iis qui in papatu adhibentur, quos antiquis illis Episcopis prorsus incognitos fuisse hospes prorsus in historia Ecclesiastica est, qui ignorat.

main_text.head: Veteres.
main_text.p: Nullam singularem potestatem in ordinatio-nibus pastorum sibi ar-rogabant: nam nec nomi-nabant per se exclusò cle-ro & populo ordinan-dum: sic Ambrosium plebs Mediolanensis E-piscopum nominat cu-jus postulatis acquie-verunt præsentes Epis-
main_text.head: Hodierni.
main_text.p: Singularem ordinatio-nis presbyterorum pote-statem, exclusò clero, sibi solis vendicant, atque hanc sibi maxime peculiarem & propriam, non fratrum presbyterorum voluntario consensu, sed jure divino, aut saltem Apostolico: ideoque impositione manuum in ordinatione, gratiam in-ternam conferri dicunt.

copi. Theodoret. histor.eccles.lib.4.c.6.Sic Augu-stinum Episcopum sibi præponi postulat Hipponensis Ecclesia Valerio Episcopo præsente, Possidon. in vita Augustin. page.notes: The first word of the page is cut off at the left edge; read as "strium" with [?]. The top paragraph and the italic paragraph are set in roman and italic respectively; the opening Q of "Quod" is a decorated initial. The section mark "5." is a small printed number above the columns. The left column's last word is completed in the full-width line below the columns ("Epis-" / "copi."). Printed line-end hyphens are kept. Possible printing irregularities: "Hodierni." and "Veteres." appear as column headings in a larger, spaced type.
